source_title: AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 56 Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor Posts
source_excerpt:
Vacancies: 56 confirmed · Posts: Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor · Job Type: Regular / Deputation / Contractual (retired faculty) · Mode: Online (Google Form) + Hard Copy · Fee: ₹2,000 / ₹500 · Last Date: 14 November 2026 · Salary: Level-14A to Level-12 + NPA · Selection: Bio-data shortlisting + Interview · Location: Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh
AIIMS Gorakhpur has invited applications for 56 Faculty (Group-A) posts on direct recruitment, deputation or contractual basis. The advertisement (No. AIIMS/GKP/RECT/FACULTY/2026-27/271 dated 15 October 2026) covers Professor, Additional Professor, Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts across medical departments.
Applications open on 15 October 2026 and close on 14 November 2026. Eligible candidates must hold MBBS plus MD/MS (or DM/MCh for super-speciality) with the required teaching experience. The institute is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, located at Kunraghat, Gorakhpur.
Submit both the Google Form and the hard-copy documents by 14 November 2026. Only the online form without the posted hard copy is incomplete.
Separate applications and fees are required for each post. One form cannot cover multiple posts.
Age and qualifications are reckoned as of 14 November 2026. Experience is counted after the qualifying degree.
Private practice of any kind is prohibited.
Official updates page: AIIMS Gorakhpur Current Notices
Application route: Google Form https://forms.gle/Ryem3xyejEtyvekPA plus hard copy by post
Official notice: Download AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026 PDF (Advt. 271)
MBBS + MD/MS (or equivalent recognised by NMC) + 14 years of teaching experience (12 or 11 years for super-speciality) → Professor – 16 posts
MBBS + MD/MS + 10 years teaching experience (8 or 7 years for super-speciality) → Additional Professor – 5 posts
MBBS + MD/MS + 6 years teaching experience (4 or 3 years for super-speciality) → Associate Professor – 18 posts
MBBS + MD/MS + 3 years teaching experience (2 years or none for certain super-speciality courses) → Assistant Professor – 17 posts
Indian nationals and OCI cardholders under Section 7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955 may apply. Retired faculty from INIs or GMCs (up to age 70) may apply for Professor (Consultant) or Additional Professor (Consultant) on a contractual basis.
PwBD: 7 seats reserved horizontally (1 Professor, 1 Additional Professor, 2 Associate Professor, 3 Assistant Professor). Physical requirements: Sitting, Standing, Walking, Manipulation by Fingers, Reading & Writing.
Who cannot apply: Candidates who do not hold the essential qualifications and the prescribed experience by 14 November 2026. SC/ST/OBC candidates get no age relaxation on unreserved posts.

What Posts Are Available? – AIIMS Gorakhpur Vacancy & Eligibility 2026
Vacancy Interpretation Note: Professor posts (16) require the longest experience. Assistant Professor posts (17) suit earlier-career specialists. Super-speciality departments have adjusted experience requirements. The full department-wise category matrix is on pages 1–2 of the notice.
Department examples with categories (as printed): Anaesthesia – Professor 01 (OBC); Biochemistry – Professor 01 (ST); Cardiology – Professor 01 (UR); Cardiothoracic Surgery – Associate Professor 01 (UR), Assistant Professor 01 (SC); ENT – Professor 01 (SC), Additional Professor 01 (SC), Associate Professor 01 (ST); and others across 31 departments. The complete grid with all category cells is in the official PDF.
Professor and Additional Professor: not exceeding 58 years
Associate Professor and Assistant Professor: not exceeding 50 years
Relaxation: SC/ST +5 years, OBC +3 years, PwBD (OPH) +5 years, Government Servant/Ex-Servicemen +5 years. No relaxation for SC/ST/OBC on unreserved vacancies. One-year experience relaxation for SC/ST on reserved posts.
Use our Age Eligibility Calculator to check instantly.
Eligible example: Candidate born 20 November 1968 is 57 years 11 months as on 14 November 2026 and is eligible for Professor. Not eligible example: Candidate born 20 November 1967 is 58 years 11 months as on 14 November 2026 and exceeds the Professor limit.
What Is the Salary? – AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty 2026
Pay is as per 7th CPC plus usual allowances including NPA (if applicable):
Professor (Consultant): ₹2,20,000 per month lump sum
Additional Professor (Consultant): ₹2,00,000 per month lump sum
Deductions apply for campus accommodation. Private practice is prohibited. Use our 7th CPC Salary Calculator for an indicative estimate.
Pay online to SBI, Giridharganj, Gorakhpur. Account: Recruitment Cell, AIIMS, Gorakhpur; A/c No. 42368584553; IFSC: SBIN0018457. The fee is non-refundable. Separate fee for each post.
Fill the application in the MS Word proforma given with the notice. Paste a photograph and sign.
Prepare Annexure-A (Brief of Candidate, PDF) and Annexure-B (PowerPoint Presentation).
Collect scanned educational certificates (SSLC to PG), experience certificates, UG/PG registration and other documents.
Submit online via Google Form for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty 2026 by 14 November 2026. Upload the documents as listed in the notice.
Send the signed hard-copy set (application printout, Annexure-A, self-attested photocopies, two passport photos, NOC if applicable) by Speed/Registered Post to Recruitment Cell, AIIMS Gorakhpur, Administrative Block, Kunraghat, Gorakhpur – 273008. Superscribe the envelope “APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF [Post Name]”. Must reach by 14 November 2026.
Use our Photo & Signature Resizer if the form requires sized images.
Submitting only the Google Form and forgetting the hard-copy post.
Applying for multiple posts with one form and one fee.
Missing the 14 November 2026 cut-off for both online and hard copy.
Using an OBC certificate issued outside 01 April 2026 to 31 March 2027.
Not uploading the required Annexure-B PowerPoint.
एम्स गोरखपुर फैकल्टी भर्ती 2026 – 56 पदों के लिए ऑनलाइन आवेदन करें
एम्स गोरखपुर ने 56 फैकल्टी (ग्रुप-ए) पदों के लिए आवेदन आमंत्रित किए हैं। प्रोफेसर, एडिशनल प्रोफेसर, एसोसिएट प्रोफेसर और असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर के पद शामिल हैं। अंतिम तिथि 14 नवंबर 2026 है।
कौन आवेदन कर सकता है? एमबीबीएस और एमडी/एमएस (सुपर-स्पेशलिटी के लिए डीएम/एमसीएच) के साथ निर्धारित शिक्षण अनुभव वाले उम्मीदवार आवेदन कर सकते हैं। प्रोफेसर के लिए 14 वर्ष, असिस्टेंट प्रोफेसर के लिए 3 वर्ष अनुभव आवश्यक है।
वेतन और चयन प्रक्रिया क्या है? सातवें वेतन आयोग के अनुसार लेवल-14ए से लेवल-12 तक। चयन बायो-डेटा शॉर्टलिस्टिंग और गोरखपुर में इंटरव्यू से होगा।
आवेदन कैसे करें? गूगल फॉर्म भरें और हार्ड कॉपी स्पीड पोस्ट से भेजें। आधिकारिक वेबसाइट aiimsgorakhpur.edu.in पर नोटिफिकेशन देखें।
Shortlisting is based on bio-data. Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview in Gorakhpur. Original documents must be produced at the interview. No TA/DA is paid. The list of eligible candidates, date, time and venue will be published on the website.
No written exam is mentioned. Selection is based on shortlisting and interview, subject to document verification.

Direct recruitment posts follow regular service conditions on probation; deputation and contractual consultant posts follow separate terms.
Best fit: Specialists who already hold the required teaching experience and want a central institute posting in Gorakhpur.

FAQs – AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026
What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty Recruitment 2026?
A: 14 November 2026. Both the Google Form and the hard-copy documents must reach by this date. No extension has been announced.
What is the age limit for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty posts?
A: 58 years for Professor and Additional Professor; 50 years for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor, as on 14 November 2026. SC/ST get 5 years, OBC get 3 years, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen get 5 years, as printed.
Is there an exam for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty, or is it interview-based?
A: No written exam is mentioned. Selection is through bio-data shortlisting followed by an interview at Gorakhpur.
What is the salary of AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty posts?
A: Level-14A (₹1,68,900–2,20,400) for Professor down to Level-12 (₹1,01,500–1,67,400) for Assistant Professor, plus usual allowances including NPA where applicable. Contractual consultant posts carry fixed lump-sum amounts of ₹2,20,000 or ₹2,00,000 per month.
Can final-year students or result-awaited candidates apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty 2026?
A: No. The qualification and experience must be attained by 14 November 2026, the application closing date. The degree and certificates must be produced as required.
Is AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty a permanent government job?
A: Direct recruitment posts are advertised as regular Group-A faculty posts. Regular appointments are made on probation and confirmed under the applicable service rules. The notice does not use the phrase “permanent government job.” Deputation and contractual consultant posts follow separate terms.
Can candidates from other states apply for AIIMS Gorakhpur recruitment?
A: Yes. The notice invites Indian nationals and OCI cardholders. No domicile restriction is printed.
Where will I be posted if I get selected for AIIMS Gorakhpur Faculty?
A: At AIIMS Gorakhpur, Kunraghat. The notice does not mention transfer liability outside the institute.
